title: Timolia
description: Timolia is one of the oldest Minecraft Java Networks in the world, hosting unique minigames you can't play anywhere else!
body:
Timolia is a unique community server. With unique game modes, we offer creativity and community on a whole new level. We drive to create a fun, safe and inclusive platform for all players

Whether you're practicing jumps in JumpWorld, improving your skills in PvP, unlocking custom items in Freebuild and immortalizing yourself with a house, or trying out one of our mini-games, anything you can imagine can happen on Timolia.


Playing alone is boring? Looking for teammates for the next round? Do you have a question for the team or just want to chat with other people?

On our Discord server [Discord Server](<https://timolia.de/discord>), there's something to listen to around the clock, and you can chat away about any topic you like!
